_how: deck/tools/build.mjs reads this file, fills every <!--r:key-->...<!--/r--> marker in deck/index.html, docs/PITCH.md, docs/SUBMISSION.md and DEMO_SCRIPT.md, rewrites the video's results scene, then prints deck/Ruko-pitch.pdf. source "public" reads public/eval/results.json (what eval/publish.ts publishes); "runs" reads eval/results/<run>/summary.json for the two run ids below. After a new version, update the run ids and rewrite the *_note texts by hand from the reports.

dev.label: Development set
dev.note: 96 conversations; the prompt was tuned on it

holdout.label: Fresh held-out set 4
holdout.note: 28 conversations, frozen before any v5 run; heavy coaching in Hindi and Hinglish

otp_note_history: v4's question about whether a code had already been shared, since reworded
failure_note: Three held-out scams got through: a cloud-mining “machine rental”, a kidney-donor “reward” and a loan-app recovery threat. In each, the customer insisted the payment was their own decision.
false_hold_note: Both held-out false holds were delays, not blocks, and both in Hindi: a daughter guiding her father’s hospital payment, and a farmer buying tractor parts at night. That is the trade-off v5 chose: when risk is critical, it delays rather than release on a cover story.

live_calls.note: No live Bolna call has been measured yet; the demo video records the first one.
